sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 150 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.

[Aqours] Chika Takami or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
